full_judgment: 5. The defendants appeared and submitted written objection against the application for temporary injunction denying the allegation made in the application for injunction stating that the Cinema Hall has been situated in plot Nos. 11106 and 11107 in SA Khatian No. 5956. But the plaintiff has no prima facie case and the balance of convenience and inconvenience are not in favour of the plaintiff-petitioner and that they are violating the terms and condition of the rules and that the licence has rightly been cancelled.
